		limit = {
			exists = character:han_517
			exists = character:han_357
		}
		character:han_517 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:han_357 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:han_158
			exists = character:han_118
		}
		character:han_158 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:han_118 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:han_1194
			exists = character:han_1012
		}
		character:han_1194 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:han_1012 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}
